lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [cheerful, then slowing down] Everything was perfect. Until... Wednesday.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [confused] On Monday, bread cost five Robux. On Tuesday... fifty.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [alarmed] On Wednesday... five THOUSAND.

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.text: [shocked] Five thousand Robux? For BREAD?!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [clear, explaining] Here's what happened. Every day, eight billion people claimed their free daily rewards. And every reward printed brand-new Robux.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: So everyone had way more money... but there was still the same amount of bread.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: And when everyone has more money, but there's the same amount of stuff... [pause] the stuff just gets more expensive.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: [flat, smug] That's called inflation. [pause] We learned it in school. You'd know if you didn't buy "Skip Math."

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [groans] Ugh. She's right.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [panicking, fast] By Thursday, a pack of gum cost a MILLION Robux. People pushed wheelbarrows full of coins to the store.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: The news anchor's tie was worth more than his car. Dad's whole paycheck bought one coffee. [pause] With thirty percent missing.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: [crying, sipping] It's the best coffee I've ever had.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.text: [panicking] Breaking news! Prices are going up so fast, this news is already more expensive than when I started reading it!

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: [screams] My fedora is worth ZERO! Who wants a MOON?!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [devastated] And my three million Robux? [pause] They bought me... one sandwich.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [desperate] I tried to sell the gold toothbrush. [pause] Nobody wanted a used gold toothbrush.

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [huge, booming] MARKETPLACE FEE!

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [screams] HALF a sandwich!

lines.speaker: BUTLER
lines.text: [robotic, cold] Sir, your payment has failed. I now work for your neighbor.

lines.speaker: TY
lines.text: [defeated, narrating] My butler quit. My limo got taken away. And my mansion...

lines.speaker: THIRTY
lines.text: [giant, booming, gleeful] Belongs to ME! Thirty percent of EVERYTHING is MINE!
